manifest.name: VECTOR-µ
manifest.description: Vector projection micronaut — EmbeddingGemma-backed AIML similarity matching, SRAI chain resolution, mesh feature projection, relation-conditioned geometry. Wo-phase compute. Served by agents/vector_match_bot.py (port 3220).

xcfe.note: Vector similarity alone does not establish executability. XCFE must validate resolved category, bindings, and permissions before Sek dispatch.

vector.match.description: Wo/Yax-phase: cosine similarity match against AIML category corpus — returns top-K candidates with pattern, template, score, field scope, and wildcard_count. Source: category_midpoint by default.

vector.project.description: Wo-phase: apply mesh_feature_projection_gate — projects fold state through relation-conditioned geometry, phase-conditioned metric gate, and principal_direction_vector; returns semantic_geodesic_distance.

vector.srai.description: Yax-phase: recursive SRAI chain resolution — EMBED→RETRIEVE→FILTER (wildcard_count_match)→RANK→SRAI (max_depth 3)→FOLD. Shared with aiml.srai.vector block. Output: aiml.srai.vector.proposal, xcfe_status: pending_admission.

vector.embed.description: Wo-phase: generate EmbeddingGemma embedding for input text — returns 256-dim L2-normalised float32 vector.

vector.health.description: Pop-phase: reports vector_match_bot.py liveness (port 3220), corpus size, last match stats.
